card.name: Handing something to another person
card.fires_on: The word for the recipient (mostly "friend", also "your", "to", "of") right after verbs like give, bet, or ask, in instructions for card tricks and games. It also fires on a few other words that come before a person or thing being addressed.

modes.label: Recipient in magic-trick steps
modes.description: "friend" or "your" after give, bet, or ask in step-by-step card or number tricks.
modes.example: - Give your<< friend>> these instructions: - Think of any number

modes.label: Other recipient or target words
modes.description: Small words or a noun that point to who receives or is cued by an action.
modes.example: Give the prepared test drink<< to>> the patient.
